instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\profile_seed.dxf. Import profile_seed.dxf. Draw a symmetric notched profile with vertices (0,0), (160,0), (160,40), (105,40), (105,70), (55,70), (55,40), and (0,40). Add CENTER symmetry line from (80,0) to (80,70), two radius 5 holes at (30,20) and (130,20), and text ACAD-28. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
